611:t_024:51.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The decisive battle at $$ラース・バビロン$$... So we'll be fighting for the future...」

611:t_024:52.en:
$$甲児$$
「We'll win...! This time, for sure.」

611:t_024:53.en:
$$刹那$$
「To open the way to this world's future.」

611:t_024:54.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Just you wait, $$サイデリアル$$. The day we drive you off Earth is almost here.」

611:t_024:55.en:
$$號$$
(And what waits for us beyond that...?)

611:t_025:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I-I won't stop! $$ハイアデス$$' battle will not end in a place like this!」

611:t_025:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Please wait for me, Lady $$エルーナ$$! Your beloved $$ダバラーン$$ will soon be at your side...!」

611:t_026:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「If the power of love is real, he'll stubbornly survive.」

611:t_026:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「But we shot down his precious battleship. We probably won't have to fight him anymore.」

611:t_026:3.en:
$$メール$$
「Even if he comes back, we'll be fine!」

611:t_026:4.en:
$$メール$$
「Because you've got the power of love too, Darling!」

611:t_027:0.en:
$$尸刻$$
「I'm sorry, Brother. It seems my strength was insufficient...」

611:t_027:1.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Perhaps they may even be able to overturn the natural order...」

611:t_028:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
(I can't believe someone whose job is guiding souls to the underworld would die that easily...)

611:t_028:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
(See you, $$尸刻$$... Sorry, but I'm going to settle things with your brother.)

611:t_029:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Damn it! How dare you do this to me...!」

611:t_029:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...Is it my age that keeps me from sustaining hatred and anger like that...?」

611:t_030:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
($$サルディアス$$... Are you really all right with $$バルビエル$$ continuing to fight like this...?)

611:t_030:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
(If he keeps letting hatred consume him, what waits for him is surely an irrevocable sorrow...)

611:t_100:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「$$ランド・トラビス$$! The time has finally come to settle things with you!」

611:t_100:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「I've always been up for it, but you're the one who kept running away...」

611:t_100:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That was a strategic withdrawal! But today, we'll fight to the very end!」

611:t_100:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I acknowledge you as an opponent worthy of setting my $$ハイアデス$$ spirit ablaze!」

611:t_100:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「Fine by me! That feels more like a man's fight than taking your jealousy out on me!」

611:t_100:5.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Has your fighting instinct ignited?! That's the spirit!」

611:t_100:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「Come on, $$ダバラーン$$! $$ガンレオン$$ and I will take you on with everything we've got!!」

611:t_100:7.en:
$$メール$$
「In the end, those two... are just alike...」

611:t_101:0.en:
$$尸刻$$
「$$クロウ・ブルースト$$... I cannot let you go any farther.」

611:t_101:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You're a sister who really cares about her brother. But words or force won't stop me.」

611:t_101:2.en:
$$尸刻$$
「I know that. That strong will is your true nature, and the reason I don't want you to fight $$尸空#pilot$$.」

611:t_101:3.en:
$$尸刻$$
「It casts a shadow over $$尸空#pilot$$'s nothingness.」

611:t_101:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Sorry... Changing how I live for someone else's sake isn't my style.」

611:t_101:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm coming through, $$尸刻$$! I've got to settle things with $$尸空#pilot$$!」

611:t_102:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$サルディアス$$! You see $$バルビエル$$ as...!」

611:t_102:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「You are correct, $$セツコ$$. He's my superior, someone to fear, and also a subject of observation.」

611:t_102:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Perhaps it's because I used to be a scholar... My curiosity seems to outweigh my hatred.」

611:t_102:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「So show me, $$セツコ$$. Show me, who never became wholly consumed by hatred, whether sorrow can heal it.」

611:t_102:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...Or so I'd like to say, but this is my job, so I'll stop you here.」

611:t_102:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...I don't know if I can stop him...」

611:t_102:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But we have to keep moving forward! We're coming through!」

611:t_103:0.en:
$$トライア$$
「Well... This ship isn't really meant for combat...」

611:t_103:1.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「There's no need to worry, Doctor!」

611:t_103:2.en:
$$トビー$$
「We're here as $$ソーラリアン$$'s close escort!」

611:t_103:3.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「We'll protect the ship!」

611:t_103:4.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Doctor, you and $$ＡＧ$$ just concentrate on controlling events.」

611:t_103:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「But I won't let some riffraff damage $$ソーラリアン$$, completed through so many people's efforts! I'll do everything I can, too!」

611:t_103:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「OK, $$トライア$$! Let's give it our all!」

611:t_104:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
(Lady $$エルーナ$$...! I shall deliver news of our victory to you at $$ラース・バビロン$$ without fail!)

611:t_104:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
(And when I do, I, $$ダバラーン・タウ$$... will pour my heart and soul into expressing all my feelings to Lady $$エルーナ$$!)

611:t_105:1.en:
$$尸刻$$
(Countless deaths, enough to distort dimensions... Where is this universe trying to go...?)

611:t_106:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
(Well... So the decisive battle is finally here...)

611:t_106:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
(If I win, Earth is finished... If I lose, I won't be able to see the battles that follow...)

611:t_106:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
(Whatever the outcome, it's a shame this is the last I'll see of the battle between Earth and $$サイデリアル$$...)
